accepted_claims: The exact assertion printed in OWR 50/2018 p. 3018 is false over every field.
The budget-2 weights (2,1,1,1) function has the displayed same-field four-subspace representation.
No nonnegative real combination of any ordinary matroid ranks on the same ground set equals the witness.
The principal universal integer separator has value -1 on the witness.
The budget-3 witness has an independent all-field representation and correctly split zero-slack obstruction.
The secondary universal K separator has value -3 on the budget-3 witness.
Both rank functions are mutual singleton-weighted polymatroid duals.
Four ground elements are minimal, including against arbitrary real normalized monotone submodular inputs on smaller ground sets.
Ambient representation dimension two is minimal.
scope_fields.credit: Budget-2 counterexample and non-MRS property: Shaddin Dughmi, Tim Roughgarden, Qiqi Yan (2011), full author manuscript Section D.2. This is a credited application to the later OWR question.
claim_limits: Original arbitrary field and unchanged ground set; no common-dimension condition is imposed.
The obstruction covers all ordinary matroid ranks with nonnegative real coefficients, not only same-field representable matroids.
No claim about enlarged-ground-set representations or approximations.
No novelty, priority, exhaustive literature coverage, human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification claim.
